polls.title: Which local development environment do you use for Drupal?
polls.description: A recurring tooling question in the Drupal Developer Survey and on the drupal.org support forums.

options.title: DDEV
options.description: Docker-based; the most recommended local environment in the 2025 developer survey.

options.title: Lando
options.description: Docker-based, multi-stack local development tool.

options.title: Docker4Drupal
options.description: Ready-made Docker Compose stack tuned for Drupal.

options.title: Docksal
options.description: Docker-based environment with a shared team configuration.

options.title: My own LAMP/WAMP stack
options.description: A hand-managed local server, no containers.

polls.title: For a new project today, do you start from Drupal CMS or Drupal core?
polls.description: Since Drupal CMS launched next to Drupal 11, the community keeps debating where a new build should start.

options.title: Drupal CMS
options.description: Recipe-driven install with curated defaults, quick to get going.

options.title: Drupal core (11)
options.description: The classic install; a smaller surface with full control.

options.title: It depends on the project
options.description: Choose per client and requirements.

options.title: Still deciding
options.description: Not settled on either yet.

polls.title: Which admin theme should be Drupal's default: Gin or Claro?
polls.description: Drupal core has decided to adopt Gin as its default admin theme, replacing Claro in 11.3.

options.title: Gin
options.description: Modern contrib admin theme, chosen as the new core default.

options.title: Claro
options.description: The core admin theme since Drupal 9.

options.title: Adminimal
options.description: Long-standing lightweight contrib admin theme.

options.title: A custom admin sub-theme
options.description: An in-house theme built for the team.

options.title: Cloudflare

options.title: Fastly

options.title: AWS CloudFront

options.title: Akamai

options.title: Pantheon
options.description: Most widely used Drupal PaaS in the 2025 survey.

options.title: Platform.sh

options.title: Acquia
options.description: Enterprise Drupal cloud founded by Drupal's creator.

options.title: Amazee.io

options.title: Charity & Non-Profit

polls.title: What is Drupal's strongest selling point to clients?
polls.description: The values business decision-makers cite most when choosing Drupal, per the 2024 Drupal Business Survey.

options.title: Security
options.description: Drupal's security track record and dedicated team.

options.title: Flexibility
options.description: Adapts to complex content models and workflows.

options.title: Reliability
options.description: A stable, predictable long-term platform.

options.title: Open source & vendor independence
options.description: No lock-in; owned by the community.
